draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test set of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: The evidence (T1.r1, T1.r2) shows Wrenfold's advantage only on the unseen test set of the same Banking and Travel domains used in training. No evaluation on other customer-service domains was performed, so the claim that the advantage "may extend" to unseen domains is unsupported speculation; the hedged "may" does not rescue it since no such domains were tested.
